title: MCUboot's PSA-crypto ECDSA adapter parses the RFC 5480 DER signature with parse_signature_from_rfc5480_encoding() in……
description: MCUboot's PSA-crypto ECDSA adapter contains a vulnerability in its DER signature parsing function parse_signature_from_rfc5480_encoding(), which does not validate length fields properly. This can cause an out-of-bounds read of adjacent stack memory when processing a crafted signature. The flaw is gated by specific PSA crypto backend configurations and does not lead to signature bypass or information leak, but may cause a denial-of-service due to memory faults on some platforms.
